UnsafePassContract.purpose: Use the documented CommandBuffer interface in a graph; native pass attachment merging is not used. This does not change approval/security settings.
UnsafePassContract.ownWrites: 24 owned colour RTHandles plus4 owned depth RTHandles declared Write using UseTexture. Per-group materials4 are distinct.
UnsafePassContract.borrowedReads: main/additional shadow handles declared Read when valid; UseAllGlobalTextures for existing shader sampling; never release or replace borrowed shadow textures or buffers.
UnsafePassContract.execution: SetRenderTarget and DrawMesh recorded inside UnsafeGraphContext; no nested Graphics.ExecuteCommandBuffer. No SetRenderAttachment in UnsafePass.
UnsafePassContract.lifetime: Remove only own beginCamera callback; release only owned RTHandles/materials after capture/failure exit. Renderer/camera asset unchanged.
UnsafePassContract.verified: full external compile-only success; no GPU validation
